duration.text: The Electronic Information Engineering at Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: NJUPT application form (fill in online).Notarized highest diploma. Prospective diploma winners must submit official proof of student status by their current school.Academic transcripts from the senior high school onwards (with official stamp).Language proficiency certificate.Passport home page, valid for more than 1 year.Resume.FOREIGNER PHYSICAL EXAMINATION FORM.Award certificate.Bank statement (over 2500USD).Non-criminal record report.

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens, in good physical and mental health.Applicants seeking a bachelor's degree should possess a high school diploma or equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 25 years.Applicants seeking a master's degree should possess a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 35 years.Applicants seeking a doctoral degree should possess a master's degree or equivalent qualifications, demonstrate outstanding academic performance, and generally be under the age of 40 years.Applicants seeking bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degrees with Chinese as the medium of instruction should have Chinese proficiency at least at Level 4 of the Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi (HSK).Applicants seeking bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degrees with English as the medium of instruction should have an English proficiency level of at least 5.5 in IELTS, 72 in TOEFL, or 100 in Duolingo.
